title: Release audit: README.md still documents `.../v0.1.0/install.sh` for the install command and fo
summary: Update both documented commands to the current release installer (v0.1.1 or a versionless latest URL) and add a README guard test that asserts the install and uninstall commands use the release installer.
requirements: README.md still documents `.../v0.1.0/install.sh` for the install command and for the uninstall command, while the release describes v0.1.1 behavior. The v0.1.0 script predates the login-shell detection, fresh-shell verification, guarded block, cross-profile uninstall, and FORGEL_CODE_PROFILE cleanup, so a new user following the documentation still gets the original PATH bug and an uninstall that can leave the new block/separator and override-profile block behind.
